Maya Chen: Free curbside pick-up: IKEA 3-tier oak plant stand + 27" HP ultrawide monitor (2560x1080, DP+HDMI). Small scratch on the bottom-right bezel but no dead pixels. Moving Friday 4–6pm in SOMA (8th St near Brannan). DM to claim. Pics: https://imgur.com/abc123
Owen Patel: Im interested in the plant stand — 4:30 works for me :raised_hands:
Maya Chen: Yep 4:30 is fine. I can leave it in the lobby. PM me your phone.
Jules: Quick q: is the monitor VESA mountable? Need to know whether to bring a stand.
Maya Chen: Yes, 100x100 VESA. Ill include the small tilt bracket.
Samir: Ill take the monitor if its still available. Can pick up at 5pm and Ill bring a DisplayPort cable.
Maya Chen: Sounds good — 5pm for the monitor. FYI gate code for the lobby: `4321`. If multiple people DMd first gets it.
Owen Patel: Awesome, sending you my number now.
Jules: If Samir flakes ill jump in for the monitor. Thanks for doing curbside, Maya.
Maya Chen: Update: Owen grabbed the plant stand (left in lobby with a sticky note). Monitor reserved to Samir. Ill label both boxes.
Samir: On my way Friday. Also happy to trade my spare Logitech MX Anywhere 3 (lightly used) for the monitor cable if anyone wants to swap.
Jules: I might take the mouse if its still around — will DM you tomorrow.
